name: Iron Vanguard
description: Aethoria's oldest warrior fraternity. They guard the frontier zones and take contracts for dangerous monster exterminations. Membership demands proven combat strength.
flavor_text: Steel forged in the Fracture does not rust.

ranks.name: Recruit
ranks.title: Recruit
ranks.description: Fresh blood on the front line.

ranks.name: Soldier
ranks.title: Soldier
ranks.description: Proven in at least one campaign.

ranks.name: Marshal
ranks.title: Marshal of the Vanguard
ranks.description: Second only to the Grand Commander.

perks.name: Combat Contracts
perks.description: Access to high-paying monster extermination missions.

name: Shadow Network
description: No public headquarters. No official charter. The Network operates through whisper-routes and dead drops. They move information, valuables, and people — for the right price.
flavor_text: Everyone leaves a trail. We follow them all.

ranks.name: Contact
ranks.title: Contact
ranks.description: You know of them. They know of you.

ranks.name: Courier
ranks.title: Courier
ranks.description: Trusted with small packages and messages.

ranks.name: Handler
ranks.title: Handler
ranks.description: You run your own network of contacts.

ranks.name: Ghost
ranks.title: Ghost
ranks.description: You don't exist. The Network denies you. This is a compliment.

perks.name: Dead Drop Access
perks.description: Find hidden caches of items in explored zones.

perks.name: Vanishing Act
perks.description: Unlocks the Phase Step skill. Escape any non-boss combat instantly.

name: Mages Conclave
description: The premier arcane research institution in Aethoria. They study the Fracture, harvest System data, and develop spells that bend reality. Entry is by examination only.
flavor_text: The System assigned you a class. We assign you understanding.

ranks.name: Archmage
ranks.title: Archmage
ranks.description: One of seven seats on the Conclave Council.

perks.name: Library Access
perks.description: Unlocks Fracture Lore knowledge. Reveals hidden System mechanics.

perks.name: Anomaly Detection
perks.description: Unlocks Rift Sense skill — detects dimensional tears and hidden paths.

name: Silver Fangs
description: An assassins guild that presents itself as a 'security consultancy'. They take elimination contracts, protection details, and the occasional political removal. Very polished. Very deadly.
flavor_text: The difference between murder and justice is the client.

perks.name: Mark of the Viper
perks.description: Unlocks Shadowstrike skill. Guaranteed critical on first attack.

name: Golden Scales Trading Co.
description: The largest auction house network in Aethoria. They deal in everything from mundane goods to life tokens harvested from dying System users. Legitimately chartered. Ethically questionable.
flavor_text: Everything has a price. We determine what that price is.

ranks.name: Registered Buyer
ranks.title: Buyer
ranks.description: Can bid on all standard listings.

ranks.name: Preferred Client
ranks.title: Preferred Client
ranks.description: 10% discount. Early access to rare listings.

ranks.name: Patron
ranks.title: Patron
ranks.description: 15% discount. Can list items. Access to life token auctions.

perks.name: Life Token Access
perks.description: Can bid on life token auctions.

name: Iron Hammer Exchange
description: A scrappier, rougher auction house that operates in the grey market. They deal in confiscated goods, dungeon salvage, and stolen System tokens. Lower prices. Higher risk.
flavor_text: No questions asked. No refunds given.

ranks.name: Fence
ranks.title: Fence
ranks.description: Can sell stolen and flagged items.

ranks.name: Broker
ranks.title: Broker
ranks.description: Runs your own stall. Access to black-market life tokens.

perks.name: Salvage Rights
perks.description: Can access dungeon salvage listings before public.

perks.name: Fencing License
perks.description: Can sell items of questionable origin.

perks.name: Black Market Life Tokens
perks.description: Access to unverified life tokens — cheaper but riskier.
